description: This file is a PHP script for selecting email addresses associated with CRM entities such as Accounts, Contacts, or Leads within the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves entity-specific fields, dynamically generates a form with checkboxes for email selection, and includes JavaScript to pass selected emails back to a parent window.
